verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Marketing Emails API can create, update and retrieve email details, plus query post-send statistics for a specific email or set of emails. Those are email-level statistics, not a per-contact history of what was sent, opened and clicked. Nothing documents a per-recipient or per-contact engagement endpoint, so this is an adjacent capability that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
